title: The sysid adoption interval under-covers under 0.1 C quantisation and 0.02-0.05 C noise: 19 of 43 admitted fits miss it
claim: Under reading noise the fit is documented to tolerate (0.05 C white) and the 0.1 C quantisation of common room sensors, sysid.adoption_decision admits slab fits whose UA error exceeds the half-width it admitted them on in 9 of 11 (quantised) and 4 of 4 (white 0.05 C) cases, 19 of 43 over the three noisy arms against a nominal 0.05, all biased high (+7 % to +35 %), and the blend carries up to 11.7 % of UA error into house_heat_loss_scale from a learner sitting at the truth; noise-free windows recover UA to 5e-14.
mechanism: slab_ua_adoption_halfwidth combines the profile-likelihood and prior widths in quadrature, both conditional on the reading noise being white with the fitted residual scale; a quantised or larger-noise room series leaves the room temperature (a regressor in the slab fit) noisy, which biases UA upward (errors-in-variables) while the profile width shrinks with the residual fit, so the narrowest (admitted) intervals are the biased ones.

evidence.unit: count (quantised_0.1C admitted fits missing their interval, of 11 admitted)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to three seats on the box; seeded counts, contention-immune

metric_definition: misses = admitted fits with |log(UA_fit/UA_true)| > the adoption half-width they were admitted on (95 % interval non-coverage; nominal share 0.05)
phenomenon_property: An admitted sysid fit's adoption interval covers the true UA at its nominal rate under every reading-noise model the fit is built for (white to 0.05 C, 0.1 C quantisation, slow drift), and the blend weight never carries a bias larger than the interval states.

null_control.note: noise-free and 0.005 C white: the interval covers at (better than) nominal; the defect appears only as noise grows

reproduction_steps: Run the harness (about 10 min on a loaded box); read RESULT *_misses and *_admitted per noise kind and the per-cell CELL lines

Leave-one-out over the 10 plant x noise cells with admissions (white_0.02, white_0.05, quantised_0.1C): miss share 19/43 = 0.44; dropping the most favourable cell (white_0.02 s_true 1.25 cr 1.4, 5/5) leaves 14/38 = 0.368
Re-run with --perturb-bar5: every admitted and missed count goes to 0
proposed_fix_scope: sysid: widen the adoption interval for regressor noise (quantisation variance d^2/12, residual autocorrelation) or test the fit's residual whiteness before admitting; a bias check against the declared plant before blending
